skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — animate these still images into a smooth flowing video with motion effects...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Animation AI – Animate Images Into Videos:

- Upload images or video clips (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG up to 500MB) and automatically generate animated video clips with motion effects.
- No need for professional editing skills; just describe the result you want and receive a finished video in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles export to 1080p MP4, batch processing, timeline preview, and common editing actions through simple prompts.
- Automatic session and credit management with free token generation for new users.
- Clear workflow for uploading, animating, editing, and exporting videos, with detailed error handling and status feedback.
